name: x_likes
description: Operate the user's own X (Twitter) Likes via natural language — list, download media, check auth health. Backed by a local x_likes_downloader MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: List and download media from your own X likes via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Operate your own X (Twitter) Likes feed via natural language. Lists liked tweets, downloads attached media (images / videos / GIFs) into a sandboxed local directory, and verifies cookie health — all driven by a local x_likes_downloader MCP server. Credentials never leave your machine.
